source_name: DeepCaImX original ten-video manual ROI panel
scope: Authenticated conversion of all ten original manual ROI files and complete-panel identity/empty segmentation arithmetic controls, plus bounded movie-header and inert checkpoint configuration inspection. No movie-to-mask model or author baseline was executed.

source_execution.identity_basis: The control receipt records no contemporaneous source commit or executable digest. Independent post-execution source reviews pin converter, ROI-source, range-inspector and checkpoint-inspector files. The retained scoring dependency is identified by its unchanged publication bytes; these identities are not an execution-environment attestation.

current_source.comparison_to_execution_source: All five listed current files equal the independently reviewed publication bytes. No new execution is inherited from this equality.

software_controls.population: All ten original recording IDs and all 1,563 manually labelled ROIs.
software_controls.interpretation: Identity masks and empty prediction masks exercised the retained segmentation arithmetic; they are not fitted predictions or model accuracy.

endpoint.primary: Arithmetic mean of segmentation F1 across the original ten videos.
endpoint.metric_rule: Strict IoU greater than 0.5 with retained highest-overlap matching; ambiguous shared-prediction matching refuses.
endpoint.aggregation_limits: Video macro summaries preserve the original panel; inference must respect eight donor clusters. The published SD convention remains unresolved.

scientific_source.manual_roi_identity: Ten official Git blob identities and SHA256 pins in the public roi_sources.json.

released_checkpoint.inspection: Authenticated model_config metadata only; no TensorFlow graph, Lambda payload or model execution.

scientific_source.donor_evidence: Independent official Allen metadata review identifies eight donors across ten videos; two pairs share donors and four sessions are outside VISp.

input_exposure: Manual ROI targets are publicly released upstream. Operator conversion read them internally and retained all target arrays outside public Git and participant input. Local separation does not make the targets historically unseen.

source_parity.checkpoint_architecture: Unresolved: released checkpoint configuration has eight neuronal channels and conditional 396-sample temporal output, while the paper describes N=15/P=9; native output shapes were not executed.
source_parity.crop_mapping: Unresolved: official movies are 512 by 512 and manual targets are 488 by 488; the original crop origin is not established.
source_parity.frame_mapping: Unresolved: raw HDF frame-index origin for author filename labels 18501 through 23500 is not established.
source_parity.tiling_assembly_trace: Original complete tiling, assembly, trace-boundary support and paper-equivalent trace preprocessing remain unqualified.

limits: No original movie-to-mask baseline, paper reproduction or same-task improvement is established.
Executed commit and executable hashes were not captured in the ROI control receipt; post-execution publication/review identity is a separate claim.
Movie-header structure and checkpoint bytes do not authenticate original crop, frame mapping or paper architecture.
All authentic target arrays, generated control masks and raw receipts remain in operator custody; only aggregate scope and immutable receipt identities are published.
No untouched evaluation, candidate authoring study or new solver/model trial occurred.
Matching collision semantics, published SD convention and the paper trace/runtime companions remain unresolved.
